description: Turn a photo or illustration into pixel art: shrink it to a pixel grid and reduce it to a few colours (or a named palette). Returns the PNG.

colors.description: Number of colours when no palette is given

image_base64.description: PNG or JPEG as base64 (or a data: URL), if there is no public URL

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of a PNG or JPEG (max 4 MB, 2048x2048)

palette.description: Palette name (pico-8, sweetie-16, endesga-32, game-boy, 1-bit) or hex colours like "#1a1c2c,#5d275d"

scale.description: Nearest-neighbour upscale of the returned PNG, capped at 1024 px

width.description: Width of the pixel grid in pixels (height keeps the aspect ratio)

name: pixelate_image
title: Image to pixel art
